No—you would not be able to spot it from Perth at that moment.

The Moon’s altitude is about **−51.9°**, meaning it is more than 50 degrees below your horizon, on the opposite side of Earth from the visible sky. Its 5.75% illumination and 27.7° separation from the Sun would otherwise describe a thin crescent, but those details do not matter while the Moon is so far below the horizon.

So your wish is safely granted: **it is impossible to see the Moon from your location then**, even with excellent eyesight or optical aid from the ground.
